title: Optimization of TiO2-based phosphopeptide enrichment for LC-MS/MS analysis of HeLa cell phosphoproteome
abstract: This study presents an optimized TiO2-based phosphopeptide enrichment protocol for large-scale phosphoproteomics. We systematically evaluated binding buffer composition, peptide-to-bead ratio, and elution conditions using HeLa cell lysates. The optimized protocol identified 12,000 phosphosites from 500 ug of starting material.
